Subject: POC kickoff — align windows & owners (success criteria + timeline)

Hi Carlos — great chatting yesterday. Per our convo, we want to lock a 90-minute kickoff for the Aurora Health POC to confirm success criteria, baseline performance, and owner responsibilities. Proposed agenda (90 mins):

- Introductions & roles (10m)
- Success criteria & acceptance tests (20m)
- Data/network/security constraints (20m)
- Demo of integration points (20m)
- Timeline & next steps + open Qs (20m)

To make scheduling painless, I attached a quick one-page draft of the success criteria (POC_Success_Criteria_v1.pdf) and an .ics with proposed windows (proposed_slots.ics).

Can you confirm which of these blocks work for your engineers and procurement?

- Tue Nov 9, 09:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Nov 10, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu Nov 11, 11:00–12:30 PT

If none of those are good, let me know two windows that work and we’ll coordinate from our side. I’ve cc’d Soojin (Solutions Eng) and Marissa (Customer Success) so they can prep the demo and acceptance checklist.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
